transcript.en: And today we're bringing you the sequel of I'm Sorry I Love You.
transcript.zh: 今天我们为大家带来《对不起，我爱你》的续集。

transcript.en: I guess a lot of our listeners enjoyed the first part.
transcript.zh: 我想很多听众都很喜欢第一部分。

transcript.en: And since it was such a romantic dialogue and hit, we're bringing part two.
transcript.zh: 既然这个对话这么浪漫、这么受欢迎，我们就带来了第二部分。

transcript.en: So it's even more romantic and I'm sure everyone is going to find some great and useful language in it.
transcript.zh: 这集更浪漫，我确信每个人都会在里面找到一些很棒且实用的语言。

transcript.en: And it's the language that we use to talk about dates.
transcript.zh: 而且这是我们在聊约会时会用到的语言。

transcript.en: So useful language for when you're going on a date.
transcript.zh: 所以你约会时能用到的实用语言。

transcript.en: Well, before we look at this date language, let's listen to the dialogue for the first time.
transcript.zh: 嗯，在开始学习这些约会用语之前，我们先来听第一遍对话。

transcript.en: I'm so relieved that your ankle wasn't broken.
transcript.zh: 你的脚踝没断，我真是松了一口气。

transcript.en: I feel just awful about this whole thing.
transcript.zh: 我对这整件事感到非常抱歉。

transcript.en: I want to make it up to you.
Let me take you out to dinner tonight, my treat.
transcript.zh: 让我今晚请你吃饭吧，我请客。

transcript.en: Thank you for such a lovely evening.
transcript.zh: 谢谢你给了我这么一个美好的夜晚。

transcript.en: The food was amazing and I had a great time.
transcript.zh: 食物很棒，我玩得很开心。

transcript.en: I wish this night would never end.
transcript.zh: 我希望这个夜晚永远不会结束。

transcript.en: There's something that I have to tell you.
I woke up today thinking that this would be just like any other day.
transcript.zh: 今天醒来时我以为这会是又一个普通平凡的日子。

transcript.en: A twist of fate brought us together.
transcript.zh: 命运的转折让我们相遇。

transcript.en: I crashed into your life and you into mine.
transcript.zh: 我闯进了你的生活，你也闯进了我的。

transcript.en: And this may sound crazy, but I'm falling in love with you, Veronica.
transcript.zh: 这听起来也许很疯狂，但我正在爱上你，Veronica。

transcript.en: It really sounds like they're falling in love.
transcript.zh: 听起来他们真的在坠入爱河。

transcript.en: Yeah, it's a really romantic thing that's going on right now, but there were some really useful words here, so why don't we take a look at language takeaway?
transcript.zh: 是的，现在正在进行的事情确实非常浪漫，不过其中也有一些非常有用的词汇，所以我们来看看语言要点吧。

transcript.en: Today we have three words for language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 今天的语言要点有三个词。

transcript.en: And the first one is relieved.
So, we have some great examples on how we use relieved and I'm really sure you can understand the meaning from the sentences.
transcript.zh: 我们有一些很好的例句来展示 relieved 怎么用，我很有信心你从这些句子中就能理解它的意思。

transcript.en: They were relieved to hear that the company would not be making any layoffs.
transcript.zh: 他们听到公司不会裁员的消息后松了一口气。

transcript.en: I'm so relieved to hear your voice.
transcript.zh: 听到你的声音我总算放心了。

transcript.en: I was worried something happened to you.
transcript.zh: 我还担心你出了什么事呢。

transcript.en: I guess relieved is like a happy or relaxed feeling that you get if you avoid something bad, right?
transcript.zh: 我想 relieved 就是当你避免了一件坏事之后，那种开心或放松的感觉，对吧？

transcript.en: I'm so relieved that didn't happen.
transcript.zh: 那事没发生，我总算松了一口气。

transcript.en: Now for our second word, pick me up.
So when you ask someone to pick you up, you're saying basically...
transcript.zh: 所以当你叫某人 pick you up，基本上就是在说……

transcript.en: Okay, so let's give a couple of examples.
My husband was supposed to pick me up from work yesterday, but he forgot.
transcript.zh: 我老公昨天应该下班来接我的，但他忘了。

transcript.en: All right, we'll have a talk with him.
Or we could also say, oh, I need to hurry up.
transcript.zh: 或者我们也可以说：哦，我得快点。

transcript.en: The taxi will pick me up at seven.
And our final word in today's language takeaway is...
transcript.zh: 今天我们语言要点的最后一个词是……

transcript.en: So, ordinary is a normal word.
transcript.zh: Ordinary 是一个很普通的词。

transcript.en: So you can have like an ordinary person.
transcript.zh: 比如你可以说一个普通人。
还有什么可以是 ordinary 的？

transcript.en: An ordinary podcast, which English pod is not.
transcript.zh: 一个普通的播客，而 EnglishPod 绝对不是。

transcript.en: And I guess now we can listen to our dialogue a second time.
transcript.zh: 现在我想我们可以听第二遍对话了。

transcript.en: This time it'll be a little bit slower, and this will help you to understand the language more clearly.
transcript.zh: 这一遍速度会稍慢一些，这将帮助你更清楚地理解语言。

transcript.en: I'm so relieved that your ankle wasn't broken.

transcript.en: I feel just awful about this whole thing.

Let me take you out to dinner tonight.

transcript.en: I wish this night would never end.

transcript.en: A twist of fate brought us together.
transcript.zh: 命运的转折让我们相遇。

transcript.en: I crashed into your life and you into mine, and this may sound crazy, but I'm falling in love with you, Veronica.

transcript.en: Okay, so we looked at some great vocabulary, and now we can look at some great phrases,
transcript.zh: 好，我们看了一些很棒的词汇，现在来看看一些精彩的短语，

transcript.en: so let's start with Fluency Builder.
On Fluency Builder today we have three great phrases, so why don't we just start with the first one?
transcript.zh: 今天的句型操练有三个很棒的短语，我们就从第一个开始吧？

transcript.en: Yeah, the first one we heard at the beginning of the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 是的，第一个是我们在对话开头听到的。

transcript.en: Okay, so we have some great examples on how we use make it up, so let's listen.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们有一些关于 make it up 用法的绝佳例句，一起来听。

transcript.en: I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.
transcript.zh: 对不起，我忘了你的生日。

transcript.en: How can I make it up to you?
I feel terrible for calling your mother fat.
transcript.zh: 我真不该说你妈妈胖，我感觉糟透了。

transcript.en: I want to make it up to her, so I got her these flowers.
transcript.zh: 我想补偿她，所以给她买了这些花。
John 又忘了我们的纪念日。

transcript.en: He's going to have to make it up to me.
transcript.zh: 他非得好好补偿我才行。

transcript.en: We can see from the examples that when you use the phrase make it up to you, you're kind of saying you want to balance something bad you did with some good action, right?
transcript.zh: 从这些例句中我们可以看出，当你用 make it up to you 这个短语时，你基本上是在说想用某个好的行为来弥补你做过的坏事，对吧？

transcript.en: Right, so if you call your mother-in-law fat.
transcript.zh: 对，所以如果你说你丈母娘胖……

transcript.en: You better buy her at least some flowers or a card or something.
transcript.zh: 你最好至少买点花或者贺卡之类的给她。

transcript.en: And the balancing good action was the flowers.
transcript.zh: 而用来弥补的好行为就是送花。

transcript.en: I don't think flowers will be enough though.
transcript.zh: 不过我觉得光送花可能还不够。

transcript.en: So we use this phrase when we want to say I'll invite you, I'll pay for you.
transcript.zh: 当我们想说「我来请你，我来付钱」的时候，就用这个短语。

transcript.en: Right, so I can say, hey, let's go get some beers.
transcript.zh: 对，所以我可以说：嘿，我们去喝几杯啤酒吧。

transcript.en: And our last phrase for fluency builder.
transcript.zh: 句型操练的最后一个短语。

transcript.en: So Erica, what is a twist of fate?
transcript.zh: 那么 Erica，什么是 a twist of fate 呢？

transcript.en: A twist of fate is an unplanned event that has a big impact on your future or your life.
transcript.zh: A twist of fate 就是一个没有预料到的事件，它对你未来或你的人生产生了重大影响。

transcript.en: Marco, can you give us an example of a twist of fate?
transcript.zh: Marco，你能给我们举个 a twist of fate 的例子吗？

transcript.en: Okay, you're supposed to catch a flight to another country, all right?
transcript.zh: 你本来要赶一班飞机去另一个国家，对吧？

transcript.en: But you're late, so you miss your flight.
transcript.zh: 但你迟到了，所以错过了那班飞机。

transcript.en: Right, so that's a twist of fate.
transcript.zh: 对，所以这就是 a twist of fate。

transcript.en: So yeah, it's like fate, it's like destiny.
transcript.zh: 是的，这就像是命运，就像是天意。

transcript.en: You weren't supposed to be on that flight.
transcript.zh: 你本不该上那班飞机的。

transcript.en: Okay, so a twist of fate.
transcript.zh: 好，所以 a twist of fate。

transcript.en: On a happier note, let's listen to the dialogue a third time.
transcript.zh: 换个开心点的话题，让我们来听第三遍对话。

transcript.en: Erika, I know you have a story of a twist of fate in your life.
transcript.zh: Erika，我知道你生活里有一个关于命运转折的故事。

transcript.en: I went to this party and at the party there was a contest, like sort of a lottery.
transcript.zh: 我去参加了一个派对，派对上有一个比赛，有点像抽奖那种。

transcript.en: You could buy some tickets and win a prize and the prize was a week-long vacation.
transcript.zh: 你可以买一些彩票然后赢取奖品，奖品是一个为期一周的假期。

transcript.en: So I went with some friends of mine and they were tired so they left early and they gave me their tickets.
transcript.zh: 所以我和一些朋友一起去的，他们累了就提前走了，把他们的彩票给了我。
我们中了那个为期一周的假期。

transcript.en: So that was a really lucky twist of fate for me.
transcript.zh: 所以这对我来说真是一个幸运的命运转折。

transcript.en: I'm sure it wasn't that good of a twist of fate for your friends.
transcript.zh: 不过我觉得对你的朋友们来说，这命运转折就没那么好了。

transcript.en: Yeah, but they were very generous and let me have the prize anyway.
transcript.zh: 是的，但他们非常慷慨，还是让我拿了奖品。

transcript.en: Well, we want to hear your stories of maybe some type of twist of fate that you've had.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们也想听听你的故事，也许是你经历过的某种命运转折。

transcript.en: Maybe love stories, maybe tragic stories, any story.
transcript.zh: 可以是爱情故事，可以是悲剧故事，什么样的故事都行。

transcript.en: So be sure to leave your questions and comments and your stories at our website, EnglishPod.com and where you can also find us to answer any questions or doubts.
transcript.zh: 所以请务必在我们的网站 EnglishPod.com 上留下你的问题、评论和故事，你也可以在那里找到我们，我们会回答你的任何问题或疑惑。
